items.title: UN Ends Three Decades of Political Mission in Somalia
items.description: The closure of the U.N. Transitional Assistance Mission in Somalia (UNTMIS) follows a two-year transition agreed with the federal government. It was replaced by the U.N. Assistance Mission in Somalia (UNSOM) in 2013 before entering its final transition phase as UNTMIS in 2024. items.description: Mohamed Abdulqadir "Shariif" has been appointed commander of the Somali Navy and Coastal Defence Forces, replacing Brig. Gen. Abdiwahab Omar. His military training in Eritrea comes at a sensitive time for the region, with relations between Ethiopia and Eritrea deteriorating and renewed fighting in northern Ethiopia raising fears of a wider confrontation.  The appointment could cause concern in Addis Ababa, particularly as Somalia has strengthened its engagement with Eritrea and Egypt amid longstanding disputes with Ethiopia over sovereignty, regional security and access to the Red Sea. items.titleIt: Somalia's Eritrean-trained naval chief appointment risks further straining ties with Ethiopia
